meta.name: Sherlock & Daughter
meta.description: Sherlock Holmes faces a sinister case risking friends' lives. American Amelia joins, seeking her father after her mother's murder. Despite differences, they solve a conspiracy and her mother's case.
meta.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

videos.title: The Challenge
videos.overview: Blackmailed and sidelined from investigating, Sherlock Holmes finds hope when a young woman arrives on his doorstep, potentially holding the key to solving the kidnapping of an ambassador's daughter.

videos.title: The Common Thread
videos.overview: While Sherlock chases a stolen carriage, he sends Amelia on a hunt across London; Amelia has her own ideas and follows her intuition closer to answers but even closer to danger.

videos.title: Partners in Crime
videos.overview: Amelia goes under cover to search for clues at Clara's home; Sherlock goes to prison under pretense of meeting his forever foe, Moriarty.

videos.title: For Kith & Kin
videos.overview: Amelia withholds details from Holmes after encountering a charming man with a pistol, but Sherlock must step in when her investigation turns fatal.

videos.title: Doubting Thomas
videos.overview: Sherlock searches for the missing jewels and their connection to the kidnapping of his friends; he turns to the insurance investigator, Birtwistle, for his assistance.

videos.title: Sound Connections
videos.overview: As Sherlock and Amelia identify the villains surrounding them on all sides, Holmes repays a favor to his oldest enemy, arranging a meeting between Professor Moriarty and the young Australian man who has suddenly become very close to Amelia.

videos.title: The Golden Fleece
videos.overview: Having cracked the code of the Red Thread's communications network, Sherlock is hot on the path of the kidnap victims, chasing a trail of breadcrumbs that leads all the way to the vaults of the Bank of England.

videos.title: The Last Dance
videos.overview: Having unmasked the Red Thread syndicate, Sherlock and Amelia must confront their enemies at the most anticipated debutante ball of the season.
